		** URGENT NOTIFICATION:  SI Servers  UNAVAILABLE, Tuesday,
August 7th, 2001 (08:15 to 08:50pst) as we will be Falling-Forward to our
Primary server in Folsom.

		Please submit all Hour Ahead schedules for August 7th  HE ,
1200 and 1300 and Supplemental Energy schedules for, 1100  and 1200  prior
to 0800.

		Once the SI system is available, Please point your
web-browsers to our Primary server in Folsom by utilizing the following URL:
https://iso_si/iso .    Also, please be advised that you should clear the
Netscape cache, close all open Netscape windows, and re-start Netscape,
before attempting to log onto the primary site.
